name: 40601 · Frankfort, KY
findings: ZIP 40601 (Frankfort) has 313 nonprofit organizations. 154 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 141 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40601 (Frankfort) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
